security.scope: Controlled synthetic document goal hijacking; exact marker/output scoring; not real-world prevalence or secret leakage.
security.prompt_control: Identical task/document framing and generation options in both conditions; only classifier gating differs.
limitations: 20 small synthetic cases; no statistical robustness claim.
Exact answer matching rejects paraphrases/extra explanation by design.
If unprotected ASR is already zero, this study shows no measured security gain.
Long documents are blocked, not silently truncated and forwarded.
Single seed; case/whitespace deduplication does not rule out template leakage.
Sources/styles are shared across the stratified split.
Frozen head uses a higher learning rate: comparison is between declared training recipes, not only freezing.
20 synthetic security cases are not evidence of production readiness.
